svg.aria-label: Self-refreshing IT Desk: A help-desk dashboard fed by the Basecamp API. A scheduled AI task fetches the board, runs 18 checks, rebuilds the page and republishes it. If any step fails, it restores the last good data, and the page shows how fresh it is.
